    {"en": "chronicle-ameriques-partie2-en.html", "fr": "chronicle-ameriques-partie2-fr.html", "es": "chronicle-ameriques-partie2-es.html"},
    {"en": "chronicle-ameriques-partie3-en.html", "fr": "chronicle-ameriques-partie3-fr.html", "es": "chronicle-ameriques-partie3-es.html"},
    {"en": "chronicle-raise-children-2026-en.html", "fr": "chronicle-elever-enfants-2026-fr.html", "es": "chronicle-criar-hijos-2026-es.html"},
    {"en": "chronicle-australia-expat-guide-2026-en.html", "fr": "chronicle-australie-expatriation-2026-fr.html", "es": "chronicle-australia-guia-expatriados-2026-es.html"},
]

DIR = "/mnt/chromeos/MyFiles/wiggmap/chronicles"
updated = 0

for group in GROUPS:
    en_file = group["en"]
    hreflang_lines = []
    for lang in ["en", "fr", "es"]:
        hreflang_lines.append\('  <link rel="alternate" hreflang="' + lang + '" href="' + BASE + '/' + group[lang] + '">'\)
    hreflang_lines.append\('  <link rel="alternate" hreflang="x-default" href="' + BASE + '/' + en_file + '">'\)
    hreflang_block = "\\n".join\(hreflang_lines\)

    for lang, fname in group.items\(\):
        path = os.path.join\(DIR, fname\)
        content = open\(path, encoding="utf-8"\).read\(\)

        # Remove existing hreflang tags \(idempotent\)

        # Insert after canonical tag

            r'\(<link rel="canonical"[^>]+>\)',
            r'\\1' + "\\n" + hreflang_block,
            content
        \)

        open\(path, "w", encoding="utf-8"\).write\(content\)

        print\("OK " + fname\)

print\("\\n" + str\(updated\) + "/24 updated"\)

import os

pairs = sorted\(os.listdir\('compare/static'\)\)

tests = ['portugal','thailand','france','germany','australia']

for slug in tests:
    matches = [p for p in pairs if p.startswith\(slug+'-vs-'\) or p.endswith\('-vs-'+slug\)]
    print\(f'{slug.upper\(\)} \({len\(matches\)} paires\):'\)
    for p in matches:
        parts = p.split\('-vs-'\)
        n1 = ' '.join\(w.capitalize\(\) for w in parts[0].split\('-'\)\)
        n2 = ' '.join\(w.capitalize\(\) for w in parts[1].split\('-'\)\)
        print\(f'  {p}  →  \\"{n1} vs {n2}\\"'\)
    print\(\)
")
